title: Automatic posting
html:
On this screen you can set the rules according to which the accounting document is produced from the source documents.

Automatic posting does two things:

  • It creates an accounting document from the source document (Finance → Cash movements → Transaction list)

  • It extends the data of the source document with the information given in the automatic posting rule

Automatic posting rules can be defined per accounting document group. These create the accounting documents in posted status as soon as the source document is completed. If an automatically created accounting document is produced in normal status, it has to be checked and set to posted.

Setting up the automatic postings is careful work, since this determines how much manual effort the handling of accounting documents will require.

An automatic posting rule consists of two parts:

  • The part identifying the source document and one particular transaction line of it

  • The part containing those parameters of the source document that have to be met for the automatic posting to apply

Automatic posting rules can be set up for the following analytical documents:

  • Invoice-based sales

  • Supplier invoice

  • Cash desk receipt and payment document

  • Documents of bank transfers

Listing accounting documents

Documents created by automatic postings only reach posted status if:

  • The balance of the debit and credit sides is zero

  • Every line contains a general ledger account

  • The mandatory cost centre and job number are given everywhere

If any of the conditions is not met, the document is produced in normal status and has to be corrected — either on the source document (for example a missing cost centre) or directly on the accounting document (for example a missing general ledger account).
